chapter: Moving to California and the war years
title: Adapting to the new sounds with single-string playing
summary: He adapted to changing music by ear, ignoring complex chords and playing single string.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: And how were you relating to the new
sounds and stuff? Well, I was relating to it like I'm playing now.
Yeah. Because anything I heard I could play.
What about the chords, though? Because the chords were getting a little more complicated.
I didn't pay that no mind.
You didn't worry too much about that.
Because I did that single string.
Yeah. Right. So you would like maybe just simplify the chords.
Let the bass player or the piano player worry about that.
When he made them changes, I was right
with him. But I didn't have the chords. I was making single string with him.
He'd make them -- change keys, and I'd listen to it.
